name: @shopify-brain/os
description: Tharros OS (Origin M1/M2) — web + api umbrella. Auth and Neon isolated from Brain.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web,worker,inngest -c cyan,green,magenta,yellow "npm run dev --workspace=@tharros/api" "npm run dev --workspace=@tharros/web" "npm run dev --workspace=@tharros/workers" "npx --yes inngest-cli@latest dev --no-discovery --host 127.0.0.1 --port 43183 -u http://127.0.0.1:43182/api/inngest"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@tharros/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=@tharros/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=@tharros/workers && npm run typecheck --workspace=@shopify-brain/jobs-meta-ads && npm run typecheck --workspace=@shopify-brain/jobs-google-ads && npm run typecheck --workspace=@tharros/web
